content_metadata.description: This video follows a motorcycle stunt rider as he embarks on a high-altitude journey in the Himalayas to set a world record for the highest freestyle motorcycle stunt show.

videoEditingDetails.description: Fast cuts and dynamic editing. Music with a driving beat.

A KTM support truck drives through a shallow river.
Scenic shots of mountains, a horse, and people crossing a bridge.

Shift from talking to motorbike close-ups.

narrativeProgression.description: The narrator prepares for the world record attempt, highlighting the high altitude and introducing the oxygen cylinder as a safety precaution.

Motorcycle stunt riding on a mountain road.

narrativeProgression.description: The challenges of finding the right location for the stunt are briefly discussed. Then, the narrator performs a series of impressive motorcycle stunts on a mountain road.

Dynamic cuts between normal speed and slow-motion footage. Upbeat music returns.

activities.description: More impressive motorcycle stunts, showcasing the narrator's skill and pushing his limits. The narrator almost crashes at one point.
The narrator crashes the motorcycle. He is helped back up by the KTM support team.

keyMoments.changeDescription: The segment ends with a crash, underscoring the risks.

narrativeProgression.description: The video showcases the narrator's dedication and skill as he pushes himself to achieve the world record. The scene ends with a crash, highlighting the risks involved in this extreme sport.

videoEditingDetails.description: Dynamic cuts between multiple camera angles. Upbeat music continues.

activities.description: The narrator recovers from the crash and they continue to travel up the mountain.
The narrator and the KTM support team arrive at Muktinath Mustang.
The narrator prepares for the world record stunt. He will be performing for 20 minutes.

The narrator prepares for the world record attempt. He explains they are at 3,664 meters, he'll be performing for 20 minutes and that he has an oxygen tank if he needs it because the bike is losing power.
The narrator prepares to begin the stunt. He removes his jacket and speaks with the audience.

storylines.description: This video effectively tells the story of the narrator's quest to set a world record for the highest stunt riding show. It blends excitement with moments of calm and reflection, creating a compelling narrative arc. By incorporating personal touches and highlighting the support of the local community, the video goes beyond simply documenting a stunt and becomes a story of passion, perseverance, and the pursuit of a dream.

youtube_description:
World record was a dream of mine since I started to ride breath gasoline. On our last chapter of the Nepal Adventure we headed to the highest pawed road that we can reach in 24hours and that was in the district called Mustang.After 17hours of grueling travel trogh Himalayas we reached it. So I attended the highest stunt show done on the planet. 20min. no pause, always full throttle and guess what we did it - unofficially now we need to wait for few weeks that we get the confirmation of guinness world records.

My name is Rok Bagoros and I am a pro freestyle streetbike rider. I began riding bikes when I was 17 and turned pro after 4 years when I signed a contract with KTM Factory. Since then my life changed and I started to travel the world to perform my freestyle live shows and competitions. On my channel I try to show you how my life looks like on and of the bike.  

I performed in Asia, South America, Europe and Middle East on the mayor events like MotoGP, Red Bull Air Race, DTM, Salon de Automovil Chile, Internatonal moto expo, EICMA, etc. On the other side I have been a stunt double for different artist like Robbie Williams and Neisha. My motosport idols are: Ken Block, Travis Pastrana, Chris Pfeiffer.
